Du blir en del av en teknisk utvecklingsverksamhet där flera olika kompetenser samarbetar för att skapa kompletta och kvalitetssäkrade system. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med kollegor från olika tekniska discipliner och omfattar bland annat projekt inom avancerade marina system och stridsfordon. Till den här rollen söker vi dig som har erfarenhet av relevanta tekniska områden och som vill utvecklas vidare inom systemkonstruktion. Ser du fördelarna med att få variation och erfarenhet från olika kunder och branscher men att utvecklas med en och samma arbetsgivare? Som medarbetare på ESSIQ får du det bästa av två världar. ROLLBESKRIVNING I rollen som systemkonstruktör arbetar du med att utveckla, utforma och verifiera avancerade tekniska system. Du arbetar med olika delar av systemutvecklingsprocessen, från kravanalys och systemdesign till implementation, test och verifiering. Rollen har en bred teknisk inriktning och vi söker flera personer med olika kompetensprofiler. Beroende på din erfarenhet och ditt intresse kan du arbeta med exempelvis kravhantering, kablagedesign, elektronik, hårdvarusystem eller test och verifiering. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar bland annat: Analysera, bryta ner och realisera systemkrav. Definiera och dokumentera hur tekniska system ska utformas. Arbeta med kablagedesign och/eller kablagemontage. Arbeta med systemdesign kopplat till hårdvarusystem och elektronik. Upprätta och säkerställa spårbarhet mellan krav, design, implementation och tester. Ta fram testspecifikationer för olika delsystem inför testtillfällen. Genomföra och analysera tester för att säkerställa att systemen fungerar enligt ställda krav. Arbeta med teknisk dokumentation och kvalitetssäkring genom hela utvecklingsprocessen. KVALIFIKATIONER Vi letar inte efter anställda, vi letar efter medarbetare – efter ESSIQ:are! Nedanstående är de grundläggande kvalifikationerna för tjänsten, men vi kommer även lägga stor vikt vid din personlighet. För att vara aktuell för uppdraget ser vi att du har: Eftergymnasial teknisk utbildning inom exempelvis systemutveckling, elektronik eller mekatronik, alternativt motsvarande kompetens genom relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet av kablagedesign och/eller kablagemontage. God förståelse för hur kabelstammar och kontakter dokumenteras och utvecklas. Erfarenhet av elkonstruktion av apparatskåp och arbete med olika typer av elektroniklösningar. Erfarenhet av tvärfunktionellt arbete i projekt med flera tekniska discipliner. Erfarenhet av industriell systemdesign eller arbete med större elektroniska system. Vana av att ta fram teknisk dokumentation och kabelscheman. Förståelse för Systems Engineering-processer, exempelvis kravanalys, specifikation, spårbarhet, förändringshantering samt testmetodik och teststrategi. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Meriterande Erfarenhet av AutoCAD. Personlighet och engagemang Du är ansvarstagande – kommer i mål, i medvind likväl som i motvind. Du är social och kommunikativ – öppen och tydlig gentemot dina kollegor, och är en produktiv problemlösare. Du är bra på att föra samtal om dig, arbetsteamet och leveransen inför en eller flera åhörare. Du är lyhörd och hjälpsam – tar in kunskap från omvärld och kollegor, och delar gärna med dig av din egen. Du är generös med tips, hjälp och stöd. OM TJÄNSTEN Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning på heltid. 6 månaders provanställning tillämpas. Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse. Lön och förmåner: Konkurrenskraftig fast eller rörlig lön. Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och generösa förmåner. Tjänstepension och omfattande försäkringar. Placering: Stockholm OM ESSIQ ESSIQ är teknikkonsultföretaget där allt börjar med dig. Med fokus på individen, flexibla lösningar och en modern lönepolicy attraherar vi de skarpaste, mest professionella och engagerade personerna i branschen. Med denna vision grundades ESSIQ år 2005, sedan dess har vi utvecklats till ett framgångsrikt företag med kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi består idag av över 250 medarbetare med olika bakgrund, personlighet och nationalitet, med en god fördelning av kvinnor och män. Vi har över 80 aktiva kunder i spännande branscher – allt från de stora aktörerna till de små innovationsföretagen. ESSIQ:s medarbetare arbetar med användarcentrerad tjänste- och produktutveckling inom följande tjänsteområden: UX & Service Design, Connected & Embedded Systems, IT & Cloud Services, Green Technology & Electromobility, Test & Quality Engineering, Agile Management, Mechanical Engineering samt Simulation & Visualization. Kompetensen levererar vi på plats hos uppdragsgivaren, inhouse och i satellit. Våra medarbetares intressen och ambitioner leder vägen – vårt mål är att göra den perfekta matchningen av individ och uppdrag. ESSIQ är ett familjärt och socialt företag med visionen att vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för alla medarbetare, oavsett roll i organisationen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid gemenskap och har ett uppskattat utbud av professionella och sociala aktiviteter. Vår kommunikationsplattform genomsyras av öppenhet, och främjar nätverkande och kompetensutbyte såväl som fritidsaktiviteter och relationsbyggande. ANSÖKAN Vi använder oss av rekryteringsverktyget Teamtailor. KONTAKT Frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta: Malin Meyer, Konsultchef, malin.meyer@essiq.se Vill du veta mer om ESSIQ? Besök http://essiq.se och följ oss på våra sociala medier!

review_candidates.title: Software Architect ID103367
review_candidates.description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! About The Role We are looking for a Product Architect to own the technical direction and architecture of a leading test management platform, while staying hands-on with the codebase. The mandatory requirements are systems architecture experience, 6+ years in software engineering with 2+ years in an architect or technical leadership role, PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, and strong English communication skills. What You Will Do Develop a deep understanding of the product codebase through hands-on experimentation and exploration. Design scalable, maintainable software architectures that meet both current and evolving product requirements. Assess and shepherd the technical delivery of products to ensure adherence to best practices and architectural standards. Drive continual improvement of development processes, tooling, and engineering workflows. Collaborate with Product Management and other stakeholders, contributing to the product roadmap, requirements, and release schedule. Identify gaps in the technical aspects of the end user experience and propose practical solutions. Estimate software development requirements and effort, propose alternatives, and prioritize development tasks. Contribute hands-on development support for escalated customer issues, maintaining close familiarity with the codebase and the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical problems directly. Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, including AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows, and assess their applicability to product and process improvement. MUST HAVES Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 2 years in an architectural or technical leadership role. Strong technical background with experience in software testing products, including TestRail. Proficiency in core technologies, including PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript; experience with modern frameworks, cloud platforms, or additional languages is a plus. Solid understanding of software architecture patterns, system design, and API-driven development. Familiarity with AI-assisted development practices and a curiosity about how emerging AI capabilities apply to software quality and engineering. Excellent English verbal and written communication skills; able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences. Ability to take raw product requirements and develop software architectures and designs to bring products to life. Self-directed, intellectually curious, and relentless in researching options to ensure the best outcomes. Performance and efficiency obsessed. Perks And Benefits Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets. Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies. Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options. Meet Our Recruitment Process Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit. If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

review_candidates.company: FAMSUN GROUP - INDIA | Grain Storage Silo & Material Handling Systems
review_candidates.description: Company Description FAMSUN GROUP - INDIA | Grain Storage Silo & Material Handling Systems specializes in engineering, supplying, and servicing grain storage silos and material handling solutions for the agri-food and feed industries. The organization focuses on delivering efficient, reliable, and safe storage and handling systems tailored to client requirements. With a strong engineering base and project execution capability, FAMSUN supports end-to-end project lifecycles from design through commissioning. The company values technical excellence, customer-centric solutions, and long-term partnerships. Team members collaborate across disciplines to deliver integrated, high-quality projects. Role Description The Silo and MHS Project Engineer will manage end-to-end engineering activities for grain storage silos and material handling systems, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to required quality standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing client requirements, preparing technical designs and layouts, coordinating project planning, and collaborating with cross-functional teams such as sales, procurement, and site execution. The role involves supervising installation and commissioning activities, resolving technical issues on-site or remotely, and ensuring compliance with safety and industry standards. The engineer will also prepare project documentation, reports, and progress updates for stakeholders, while maintaining clear communication with clients. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Indore, with both on-site work and some work-from-home flexibility. Qualifications Strong project engineering and project management skills, with experience in end-to-end project execution for industrial or material handling systems. Proficiency in project planning, including scheduling, resource allocation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Solid foundation in electrical engineering relevant to silo and material handling systems, including understanding of panels, motors, drives, and control systems. Effective communication skills for interacting with clients, contractors, and internal teams, and for preparing clear technical documentation and reports. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Experience in grain storage, bulk material handling, or similar industrial projects is highly beneficial. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, use CAD tools, and work with standards and regulations related to safety and quality. Strong problem-solving mindset, willingness to travel to project sites when needed, and ability to work in a hybrid environment from Indore.

review_candidates.title: Senior Licensing & Development Manager
review_candidates.description: Department: Partnerships & Media Location: Zurich Description As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry. Join the team and support us on our mission. THE POSITION The Senior Licensing & Development Manager is part of the Licensing & Retail (L&R) team which is responsible for setting the strategy, objectives and deliverables of event and 365 licensing & retail programs to deliver against budget, meet fan demands and stakeholder expectations. In addition, a key objective is to improve the collaboration and integration of licensing & retail needs and opportunities in the wider commercial partners and media strategy and teams. These are your key tasks: Responsible for the identification, negotiation and management of all official licensing contracts and licensees (relating to both event and 365 licensed & retail business) both mono-branded and branded. Work collaboratively and pro-actively with the relevant stakeholders to establish the relevant licensing program needed to meet fan demands. Build strong professional relationships with other teams and functional areas to drive the understanding, integration and opportunity of L&R. Pro-active contribution to the overall business strategy, provide strategic input and business knowledge and insights. Management of licensees’ contracts and other appointed relevant providers as aligned with the senior management team. Work with data and insights teams to inform the licensed business and, where possible and required, contribute to the delivery of key data to drive future business and overall insights for the commercial P&M division. Support in the sales and royalty reporting processes and systems working closely with the senior management team and particularly the team lead retail & planning. Together with the L&R team plan and work with the official licensees to drive product, promotion and distribution strategies for wholesale and FIFA d2c retail. Together with the senior L&R management team drive an integrative approach and work streams with the MBBI team in relation to developing and optimising marketing opportunities with branded licensees. Together with the senior L&R management team develop the brand strategy, product category and product segmentation to deliver wholesale and D2C retail business. Identify new licensed products business streams in digital, phygital and other innovative business opportunities and work with applicable teams to develop such products. Develop FIFA licensed business across all relevant and applicable territories. Identify and share market trends and customer needs to translate them into strategic actions to drive and build FIFA IP equity, brand, retail & product exposure to ultimately drive and grow revenue. Develop best in class key licensee management in aligned with senior L&R management team. Any other related L&R matters as assigned by Head of Licensing & Retail. Together with the senior L&R management team pro-actively manage documents, boiler plates, systems and documentation processes deliver against legal, governance, import/export, compliance and sustainability needs and provisions, working closely with the relevant teams (e.g legal, compliance, tax, logistics). Build a strong relationship with the commercial partnerships team to identify, drive and manage licensed business opportunities with commercial partners current and future. Pro-actively contribute to workflow processes and systems to drive efficiencies and effectiveness. YOUR PROFILE We work hard at FIFA. We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative. And we respect our values. Always. For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset. The specific competencies we require for this position are: At least 8 years’ experience and relevant background in licensing, account management, or other relevant position working for an agency, rights holder or licensee. Proven ability to implement, analyse and improve processes, measure results, and achieve financial goals Experience in the sports and/or commercial sector is a must Understanding of the interaction of product, retail and marketing Knowledge of legal and financial matters in relation to the licensed business Relevant business degree Fluent in English, both verbal and written form Proficiency in any other language is an asset Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel Technology and innovation savvy Experience working with contract management system Excellent understanding of GTM and product development processes and timelines Strong understanding of financial statements and the financial and legal aspects of licensing Strong stakeholder (internal & external) management skills Excellent time management and organisational skills Excellent communication skills Energetic, positive and with a can-do attitude Team player Willingness to travel on a frequent basis PERKS & BENEFITS The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters. Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits: Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym. Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all. Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth. Continuous learning : We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it. Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions. Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation. Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport. Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance. Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职责描述: 【定位】 开发面向汽车及汽车零部件制造领域的轮式双臂机器人，主要用于物料搬运与拾放作业，有效载荷约 10–15 公斤，生产节拍需与现有生产工艺相匹配。 带领广州硬件团队——机械、电气、嵌入式、控制、集成与测试。全面负责机器人本体：轮式底盘、双臂关节模组、执行器、电源、感知与整机集成，从对标拆解、自研设计到量产交付，最终在客户产线现场落地运行。 核心能力 1.硬件架构与技术路线：负责机器人硬件整体架构设计、技术路线选型与关键方案评审，对性能、成本、可靠性与合规性（电磁兼容、安规）负总责。 2.系统集成能力：以驱动、传动、传感、控制一体化设计为目标，跨学科统筹机械、电磁、硬件、控制与测试工程师，解决高精度装配、线束布局、传感器标定及热管理、低噪音等技术瓶颈。 3.测试与可靠性体系：规划硬件测试策略、可靠性方案（DVP）与电磁兼容及环境测试方案，定义硬件验收指标，并通过团队推动问题闭环；工作重心在测试体系规划与验收标准定义，而非亲自执行全部测试用例。 4.项目与风险管理：对接机械、软件、算法、生产与测试，主导硬件端项目推进，识别硬件风险点并推动转产，解决批量生产重大硬件问题；主导重大硬件故障根因复盘，推动设计迭代优化。 5.团队建设与规范沉淀：负责硬件研发团队搭建、人员分工、任务排期与技术指导；建立硬件设计规范、器件库与评审规范，输出硬件知识库，沉淀机器人硬件平台。 6.供应链协同能力：管理关键供应商的技术评估与改进，确保零部件质量与供应稳定；优化物料清单成本，完成器件选型与面向制造的设计优化（DFM），推动产品从研发样机稳定量产。 7.工业现场适配能力：确保硬件满足工厂现场要求——物料搬运的节拍与连续作业占空比指标、产线粉尘与电磁环境适应性，以及与产线人员协同作业的安全合规要求。 优先条件 1.具备机器人硬件平台量产经验（移动操作、轮式双臂、工业或协作机器人）优先 2.主导过机器人关节模组从 0 到 1 的开发，精通高扭矩密度、低转动惯量、轻量化、热管理与低噪音设计者优先。 3.参与过结构件工艺评审、模具开发、样品验证与产能爬坡；熟悉各类机械加工、装配与表面处理工艺。 4.熟悉机器人动力学，能结合运动学与动力学模型开展结构刚柔耦合仿真分析（ANSYS、ABAQUS、SolidWorks Simulation）者优先。 5.具备从 0 到 1 组建硬件研发组织的经验：团队与流程搭建，并同步搭建供应链。 6.具备面向工业物料搬运的移动操作或轮式双臂平台经验，包括 10–15 公斤级载荷的耐久性设计与连续作业可靠性者优先。 7.熟悉汽车行业质量与过程标准（APQP/PPAP、IATF 16949 或同等标准）及产线集成要求者优先。 任职资格: 1.机械工程、电气工程、机电一体化、自动化或相关专业本科及以上学历，硕士优先。 2.移动操作、轮式双臂、工业或协作机器人领域 5 年以上硬件研发经验，其中 2 年以上硬件团队管理经验。 3.主导过至少一个完整机器人硬件项目：需求定义、方案设计、样机开发、可靠性验证（DVP）到量产交付的全流程。 4.深入理解机器人关节模组：熟悉电机、谐波与行星减速器、编码器、力矩传感器与驱动器的选型与集成，具备主导并统筹现场装配、调试与问题排查的能力。 5.熟悉电源系统、电机驱动（磁场定向控制）、传感、电磁兼容及安规等合规设计；了解轮式底盘传动与电池系统设计。 6.具备物料清单成本管控与供应商管理经验，能主导器件风险评估与供应商技术评审。

review_candidates.title: Personal Assistant
review_candidates.description: Company Description Mark International Kidney Centre is a specialized healthcare facility focused on delivering comprehensive kidney care services. Located in Kathmandu, the centre is dedicated to providing safe, effective, and patient-centered treatment in a professional clinical environment. Multidisciplinary teams work together to support patients through diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing management of kidney-related conditions. The organization values reliability, confidentiality, and respectful care for all individuals. Team members are expected to contribute to a collaborative atmosphere that prioritizes patient wellbeing and operational efficiency. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Personal Assistant role based in Kathmandu. The Personal Assistant will provide day-to-day administrative and organizational support to senior staff, including managing calendars, scheduling appointments, organizing meetings, and coordinating travel arrangements. Responsibilities include maintaining accurate records, handling correspondence, preparing basic reports or documents, and ensuring that files and information are well organized and accessible. The role involves managing diaries, assisting with clerical tasks such as data entry and document formatting, and facilitating clear communication between internal teams and external partners. The Personal Assistant is expected to handle sensitive information discreetly, prioritize tasks efficiently, and support the smooth running of daily operations within the kidney centre. Qualifications Strong Personal Assistance and Executive Administrative Assistance skills, with experience supporting senior professionals. Excellent Communication abilities, including clear written and verbal communication and professional telephone and email etiquette. Proficiency in Diary Management, including scheduling, organizing appointments, and coordinating meetings. Solid Clerical Skills, such as document preparation, filing, data entry, and basic record keeping. Good organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks. Comfort with common office software (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, email, calendar tools) and basic computer literacy. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion and integrity. Previous experience in a healthcare or clinical environment is an advantage but not required. Minimum of a high school diploma; additional training or certification in administration or office management is beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Kathmandu, collaborate with diverse teams, and interact respectfully with patients and colleagues.
